title: Gummi round7: History dispatch phases and shared structural snapshot support
status: Research and isolated structural-support implementation. No History action, capability, IPC or WPF integration.
corrections: Round6's tentative phase1-only entry is superseded: native cursor input also exposes History in phase6 with a specific mode/corner predicate.
287B20 refreshes slicing tint/visibility via269FB0. It does not rebind grid handles.
The help-active field is BYTE editor+9072. Adjacent bytes are not a lock.
282A40 hides the cursor and retires its helper task users without clearing retained mode/selection values. Hidden phase1 does not require mode0 or valid old selection pointers.

undo.effect: Selected slot=current%4; remove group1, recreate group0, set side0, decrement current.

redo.effect: Advance current, select modulo4; remove group0, recreate group1, set side1.

native_contract.menu_route: 26CBB0 phase1 ->26D620 menu71/70 or input subcode0/1 -> Undo/Redo. Help overlay branch preempts this dispatch.
native_contract.cursor_route: 2878E0 ->2846E0 -> Undo/Redo ->287B20 -> sound. The additional287820/2861D0 helpers share the predicate but have no direct code caller in the current database.
native_contract.cursor_mode15: Allowed only if cornerA+2744 or cornerB+2752 is null. A complete box prevents native History for this mode.
native_contract.forbidden_contexts: Preview phase4; editor modal/list phases outside1/6; transient variant/single-drag/group-drag modes5/6/7; even in-progress box-selection modes12/14/16/18/20/22/24; palette mode23.
native_contract.transaction_begin: 264600 is called inside synchronous commit/delete helpers immediately before recording/removal/placement. There is no proven universal persistent 'transaction open' byte. Current cursor mode, deferred nextmode, initialization/input latch, motion and menu state distinguish suspended edit phases.

native_contract.phase6_exit: 280760/282AB0/286D20 unwind transient edits as appropriate.263370 calls282A40: nulls helper globals and task users, releases widget, sets hidden4/clearsactivation8.26E000 observes hidden cursor and returns to saved menu/list/palette phase. Null-user helper tasks later retire via1500B0.

transient_tasks.manager: Both belong to current GM manager AF9F08==module+8, not OBJ manager AFA700.

native_contract.quiescent_policy: Support captures on the established game thread after normal update. It additionally requires mode==nextmode, released button/init latches and no help/motion/special menu. These are conservative stable-snapshot handshakes, not invented unlock/gameplay conditions.

api.dependencies: Include after GummiEditorFeatures.inl inside the existing bridge namespace. Uses its F/ReadSpan/Global/HostReady/TaskList/NamedCamera/ModuleListed/Same helpers, common Readable/DecodePacked/g_base and Win32 HeapAlloc/GetProcessHeap/HeapFree. No native engine function is called.
api.public_entry: bool CaptureStable(Direction, Snapshot& first, Snapshot& second, Error&). Caller supplies two distinct noncopyable Snapshot objects; each owns host-heap buffers and releases them in its destructor.
api.directions: Inspect validates a graph/window without requiring an available operation; Undo selects current and requires a removal match; Redo selects current+1. An empty history is valid for Inspect.
api.single_capture: Capture(Direction,Snapshot&,Error&) is a locally consistent single observation. Snapshot.valid means only that observation passed structural checks. It is not an atomic snapshot or permission to call History.
api.freshness: CaptureStable performs two full independent captures and exact byte comparisons of captured owner/phase/palette/grid/index/parameter/part/task/object/deletion/history fields. Both validity flags are cleared on any failure/mismatch. Same only compares valid snapshots. No automatic retry.
api.ownership: Buffers use the trainer process heap. They never allocate from the native part/menu heap. Snapshot includes process addresses for identity comparison and must not be copied verbatim to an export file or IPC.
api.scope: Pure structural support; no GummiHistoryHandle, native history call, callback hook, FeatureDefinition, command or capability is present. Slots439..446 remain reserved.
api.thread: Requires existing nonzero current game-thread identity, nonzero fresh host heartbeat and enabled bridge. This code does not install hooks or read an external process.

implemented_validation: Module71, owner classes/backlinks, correct main/tiny editor, current layer, menu/part heap identities, complete sorted reciprocal GM/OBJ scheduler lists, active editor fiber, current camera registry/free list.
Phase1 hidden cursor and no published helper users; phase6 visible settled supported tool mode, valid prior phase1/2/3, exact live helper task tuples and required native input gates.

Checked positive grid dimensions and product<=32768 from the covered-cell WORD anchor|0x8000 format, native cell/scratch allocation counts, disjoint readable storage, positive finite cell sizes and finite grid positions.
All208-byte cells, exact linear indices and six clamped neighbor links, two index layers, valid layer roots and current selection handles when visible.

Complete bounded OBJ/deletion/placed lists with cycle/tail checks. Every placed part occurs exactly once, belongs to a live priority20000 OBJ task, current camera/parameter row and one anchor; deleted/ghost objects cannot masquerade as placed parts.

Parameter lookup reproduces first-match identity only for directly representable rows0..254; it performs no native TLS/fallback call. Full used prefix copied, including previous rows. Native >255 aliases/fallback are rejected.

Both layer owner/root/index/paint relations, correct single-cell cost encoding, connected multicell coverage through actual grid neighbors. Connectivity matches recursive native2600A0 clearing; detached islands reject.

Four-slot history window and side/order invariants, counts0..1000, all active176-byte record payloads, finite position/scale/matrix/size, exact camera and current-grid handles, layer/palette/boolean bounds.
Selected removal group binds each unique layer/anchor to the current owner's part ID. It does not assume every historical group matches today's owners.
Part transforms, parameter prefix, palette, task records, raw cell records and all active history records are copied into trainer-owned buffers and compared in the stable helper.
explicit_limits: No native reconstruction/resource readiness has been granted. A passing Snapshot is not NativeCallReady.

Numeric transform finiteness and graph connectivity are implemented, but float32 rotated-size/division/truncation parity, exact coverage-vs-transform equivalence and sequential removal/reinsertion simulation remain separate required checks.

Ghost/group/detail pointers are captured as identities; their transitive model/HUD lifetime is not claimed fully validated. Snapshot task group bytes are copied; compatibility of all restored task groups with the native dispatcher remains a later call gate.
Current parameter rows are checked, but BAR/MDLX/MSET/texture/bone/variant resource spans and first-match dispatch must be validated before native reconstruction.
Part allocator gaps, deferred-delete lifetime and all additional model/task allocations remain open. Memory used counters alone do not prove allocation success.
Prospective signed cost arithmetic and resource270/271/272 HUD/message/animation dependencies remain open before native Undo/Redo.

Structural budgets are2048 task nodes (reused owner contract),4096 nodes per OBJ/deletion list and32768 cells. The object-list budgets are implementation resource limits, not a claim of a native fixed capacity.

Two reads on the engine thread detect observed changes, not an unobservable exact address/content ABA between reads. No independent synchronization against arbitrary external mod writers or mutation after return is claimed.
No live editor test, game mutation, save write, UI action, product integration or release build was performed.
remaining_implementation_sequence: Extend the existing Snapshot with validated current BAR/resource ownership and exact per-record model/motion/variant dependencies; close only constructors reachable from selected additions.
Using the captured graph, simulate selected removals then additions with the actual float32 placement formulas, group masks, palette and prospective cost/HUD consumers.
Compute required native allocations using the actual part allocator gaps plus current model/task heap contract, retaining deferred objects until native cleanup.

Review native cursor-route refresh287B20/269FB0 dependencies against the same copy. After final same-frame recapture, expose exactly one Undo or Redo call followed by the appropriate route refresh; discard old pointers and do not retry partial failures.
Only after those obligations are implemented and tested should Root assign commands439..446, add WPF/catalog integration and perform any separately authorized runtime tests.
